name: Naruse Himari
source:
My parents passed away when I was a little kid. I closed my heart to everything. I barely talked at all, and I stopped smiling altogether.

But when I saw how hard everyone was working, and when I realized how much they cared about me, I remembered how to smile again. Now I'm able to work with the guests myself! I do my best every day for the sake of the lodge and my loved ones.

When I'm not helping out at the lodge, I like to make herbarium bottles.

[From the [url=https://sprite.net/everlastingflowers/character/himari/en]official website[/url]]
